title: Preserve lowercase GPIF minor key modes
scope: Correct case handling for GPIF key modes without changing transposition behavior or broadening accepted unknown modes.
acceptance: A valid Mode value of minor parses as IsMinor=true and exports to an AlphaTab minor key.
Test Major, major, Minor and minor with nonzero accidental counts and adjacent key changes.

resolution: GPIF key import now accepts the exact Major, major, Minor, and minor spellings plus an empty major default. Each adjacent measure header retains its independent nonzero accidental count and minor flag, while GP8 emits canonical Major or Minor tokens and Go reimport preserves the values. Unknown mode text keeps permissive parsing compatible by projecting to major, but now produces GPIF.MasterBar.Key.Mode.InvalidValue as an unsupported-feature diagnostic for selected strict rejection. Focused public API, exact wire, reimport, and isolated pinned AlphaTab evidence covers the supported spellings and unknown behavior. Transposition-derived key behavior remains outside this ticket.
